notes.title: 1.4.4.0 Small update to fix FPS issue
notes.content:
There was an issue with the framerate after a recent windows update that caused the game to stutter in an annoying way, leading to max framerate of around 20-30fps. I've updated the project to Gamemaker Studio 2 (from 1.4) and hopefully fixed this issue. Let me know if you find any problems with this update, thanks!

<3 Fermenter

notes.title: Neighborhorde, My New Game, Out Now!
notes.content:
[img]https://static1.squarespace.com/static/5313f4d2e4b02a8d2512ef9d/t/591b572ec534a54e1e93c821/1494964768903/Neighborhorde+Promo[/img]

Hi again Spingunners!

First of all, I haven't forgot about you all. I've still got some rad things in the works for SPINGUN. More news on that soon!

Lately though, I've been working crazy hard on my newest game, [b]Neighborhorde[/b], a super silly couch co-op shoot-em-up!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/446760/Neighborhorde/

After over 2 years of development, I'm super proud to finally bring this to you all. It's on sale now for $3.99! If you're interested, or just want to support me and the games I make, check out Neighborhorde. I'd love to know what you think!

FYI, we've also released Neighborhorde on Xbox One and PlayStation 4! I know this is Steam, and talk of horrid consoles is a no-no, but honestly it's freaking awesome to have my work on all of these platforms.

Stay tuned for more SPINGUN, coming at you soon!

Cheers,
Andrew

notes.title: SPINGUN Launch Week Competition!
notes.content:
Alright, SPINGUN is launched, and the fun is just beginning. :D

[h1]Competition Rules[/h1]

[b]// Summary[/b]

It's simple! There are 15 leaderboards in game that are looking a bit empty at the moment. I challenge you to get the best times you possibly can by the end of next week.

All leaderboards are up for grabs: both "Endless" modes, all 8 "Zones", 3 "Bosses", "Ballpit", and "Total Kills".

The official deadline for your times and rankings will be next Friday, November 18th, at 11:59PM (EST).

[b]// Prizes[/b]

The Top 3 times for each leaderboard will receive an exclusive fancy boost trail, Gold, Silver, or Bronze, depending on how they ranked.

(1st place will receive all trails, 2nd place will receive Silver and Bronze, and 3rd place will receive only Bronze.)

All Top 3 times will also receive a free Steam Key for my other game, "David."! (Only one key per winner.)

[b]/////////////[/b]


Let me know if there are any questions.

Thanks for playing SPINGUN. Good luck and have fun!
